old_headline: What is he sparing us by not showing us everything?
new_headline: BUT THE THUNDER OF HIS POWER WHO CAN UNDERSTAND?

new_headline: WHAT IS MAN THAT THOU ART THUS MINDFUL OF HIM, AND THE SON OF MAN THAT THOU VISITEST HIM?

new_headline: DID WE NOT SAY WE WOULD NOT TRANSGRESS, WE WOULD NOT OFFEND ANY MORE?

new_headline: NONE CAN STAY THY HAND, OR SAY UNTO THEE, WHAT DOEST THOU, OR WHY DOEST THOU SO?

new_headline: HOW SHOULDEST THOU PUT US THAT HAVE BEEN REBELLIOUS AMONG THE CHILDREN, AND GIVE US THE PLEASANT LAND?

old_headline: Who is watching the path we ask him to make plain?
new_headline: WHO IS HE THAT SAITH AND IT COMETH TO PASS, IF THOU COMMANDEST IT NOT?

new_headline: WHEREFORE SHOULD A LIVING MAN COMPLAIN, A MAN FOR THE PUNISHMENT OF HIS SINS?

new_headline: WHO AM I?

new_headline: O LORD GOD OF HOSTS, WHO IS A STRONG LORD LIKE UNTO THEE, OR TO THY FAITHFULNESS ROUND ABOUT THEE?

old_headline: Where do we still want his salvation kept private?
new_headline: HOW SHALL MEN BELIEVE IN HIM, OF WHOM THEY HAVE NOT HEARD?

old_headline: Who needs to be brought into a large place?
new_headline: WHO SHALL NOT FEAR THEE, O KING OF NATIONS?

old_headline: If the night is his, why are we afraid of it?
new_headline: WHEN SHALL WE ARISE, AND THE NIGHT BE GONE?

old_headline: Do we worship a God we think we can manage?
new_headline: EVEN THOU, OUR GOD, ART A CONSUMING FIRE, AND WHO KNOWS THE POWER OF THINE ANGER?

new_headline: WHO SHALL SEND FORTH LABOURERS, BUT THE LORD OF THE HARVEST?

new_headline: LORD, WHAT WILT THOU DO FOR THY GREAT NAME?

new_headline: HAVE WE NOT ALL ONE FATHER, HAS NOT ONE GOD CREATED US?

new_headline: LEST WE BE FULL, AND DENY THEE, AND SAY, WHO IS THE LORD?

new_headline: HOW THEN CAN MAN BE JUSTIFIED WITH GOD, OR HOW CAN HE BE CLEAN THAT IS BORN OF A WOMAN?

old_headline: Are we asking for a trickle from a river he already poured out?
new_headline: WHAT IS THE ALMIGHTY THAT WE SHOULD SERVE HIM?

old_headline: WILL WE STIR OURSELVES UP TO TAKE HOLD ON GOD?
new_headline: ART THOU NOT FROM EVERLASTING, O LORD OUR GOD, OUR HOLY ONE?

new_headline: BUT WILL GOD IN VERY DEED DWELL WITH MAN UPON THE EARTH?

new_headline: WE HAVE SINNED, WHAT SHALL WE DO UNTO THEE, O THOU PRESERVER OF MEN?

new_headline: BEHOLD WE ARE VILE, WHAT SHALL WE ANSWER THEE?
